_comment: MakeHardware house defaults for KiCad, loaded through Konnect's
save_project_config. Every number here is one sch-lint or pcb-lint
checks, so changing one means changing the gate's default too.
Scaffolded by /hw-new-project into the project root.

net_classes._comment: Widths a router can actually enter a pad with. See pcb-lint PCB-TRACKW: a net class wider than the pads on its nets is unroutable and nothing warns you. Route at these, then widen the power nets and re-run DRC.
